caption: The drawing features two depictions of a gravy spoon, both shown on a rectangular section with a muted beige and brown marbled background. The spoon on the right is drawn in a more detailed and three-dimensional style with shading to indicate its metallic surface, showing a long, slightly curved handle and a deep, rounded bowl. The handle has a subtle decorative pattern near the end. To the left, an outline rendering of the same spoon appears in a simple line drawing, providing a top-down view. Underneath the shaded spoon, there are handwritten notes, including the words "GRAVY SPOONS," "ACTUAL SIZE," and numerical or catalog notations, accompanied by a signature near the bottom right corner of the drawing. The entire artwork is mounted on a piece of cream-colored paper.
title: Silver Gravy Spoon
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
